items.name: thesis-progress
items.title: Thesis Progress
items.description: Report where the thesis stands in numbers: word count per chapter against the plan, placeholders left ([[FILL]], [[CITE]], [[FIG]]), citation health (cited keys, undefined keys, unverifiable entries), notes read versus reading list, open items in the research log, and days to the next deadline. Use at the start of a working session, before a supervisor meeting, or whenever the answer to how far along am I is a guess.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
